row: Mission Paws'ible rescue, rehabilitate and re-home homeless animals. Our videos are uplifting and inspiring in the hope to activate others to rescue or to adopt their new best friend. We are a registered Australian Tax Deductible Charity saving animals in Bali, Indonesia in partnership with Yayasan Proyek Peduli (Registered Indonesian Charity) and USA 501c3 USA Tax Deductible Charity Global Canine Cavalry.
